review: Original source action key, queue filters, candidate image identity and map reader are retained. A uniquely declared object receives a name only from its exact source selector under the matched pinned object source. Names load once per parent refresh and filters reuse them. The object module now accepts an already verified battle reference, preserving own packet/inventory checks and deriving identical object data without loading the battle twice. Original standalone callers still validate the battle entry. Qt itemActivated uses the existing enabled position button route, preserving source validation and same-host history. Compact controls use native layouts; ignored vertical size policies allow the adaptive splitter to fit its actual viewport. Default action prose is shortened through exact presentation mappings and full original text remains in the existing notes control. Source-loss cleanup clears after notes callbacks. No new catches, retries, game operations, provider calls or dependencies.
